title: Inquest called in shooting
article: A coroner's inquest into a police shooting near Craigallechie has been called.

Twenty-nine-year-old Graham Maryancik, a resident of Revelstoke, was fatally wounded from a gunshot fired by an unnamed third-year Sicamous RCMP officer last May, following a confrontation while attending a motor-vehicle accident.
Maryancik had a history of violent behaviour.
The inquest will be held in Kamloops in September of this year.
